WITH matched AS (
  SELECT 
    r.riskandmarginpivot,
    o.timespan
  FROM riskandmargin r
  INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
),
bucket_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    timespan,
    COUNT(*) AS bucket_count
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY timespan
),
bucket_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    timespan,
    bucket_count,
    CAST(bucket_count AS DECIMAL) / (SELECT SUM(bucket_count) FROM bucket_counts) AS share
  FROM bucket_counts
),
avg_share_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share_value
  FROM bucket_shares
),
kept_buckets AS (
  SELECT 
    timespan,
    bucket_count,
    share
  FROM bucket_shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share_value FROM avg_share_calc)
)
SELECT 
  SUM(bucket_count) AS total_count,
  AVG(share) AS avg_share,
  AVG(share) - (SELECT avg_share_value FROM avg_share_calc) AS avg_excess
FROM kept_buckets;
